summary: First iteration end-to-end test of KiddyMarket. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (family/PIN, children CRUD + NFC assoc & duplicate 409, products CRUD + category filter, credit/debit/purchase with 400/402 edge cases, transaction ordering & child filter). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): profile selection shows seeded Lucas & Emma, child dashboard opens with Carte Bleue + balance, PIN 1234 opens Caisse, cart add + Payer + simulate-pick-child + confirm shows success flow, insufficient balance shows 'Tu n'as pas assez d'argent pour cet achat' with correct amounts, Boutique add-product-fab creates product (visible in list), Enfants add-child sheet creates child (toast 'Enfant ajouté'), Historique tab displays transactions with per-child filter chips. One non-blocking web warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' (react-native-web).

issues: react-native-web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (Button/Card/Fab/etc). Non-blocking on web, will become an issue in future RN Web versions. Consider migrating to boxShadow or Platform.select.

react_native_issues.issue: PaymentSheet declares a prop named `children` (array of Child) which shadows React's reserved `children` prop. Works today because it's passed explicitly, but may collide with React tooling / future strict typing. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/payment-sheet.tsx:25 and /app/frontend/app/parent/index.tsx:152. Recommend renaming to `kids` / `profiles`.

action_items: (Optional) Rename PaymentSheet `children` prop to a non-reserved name (e.g. `kids`) in payment-sheet.tsx and its caller in app/parent/index.tsx to avoid shadowing React's reserved children prop.
(Optional) Replace deprecated `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` (or wrap via Platform.select) to silence the react-native-web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB `_id` via clean(). Uses uuid ids, proper 400/402/404/409 status codes and Pydantic models.

All frontend interactive elements expose testID as documented (parent-access-button, pin-key-*, product-tile-*, pay-button, pay-child-*, confirm-payment-button, payment-done-button, add-product-fab, save-product-button, add-child-fab, save-child-button).
seed_data_creation: Startup seed created family (PIN 1234), Lucas (12,00 €), Emma (5,00 €) and 7 sample products. Tests also created TEST_UI_Item product and TEST_UI_Kid child via UI which remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + /api. Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_kiddymarket.py (15 tests, ~3s). Frontend tests require mobile viewport 390x844 and wait ~2s for FadeInDown animation before selecting child-card-* elements. PaymentSheet flow: click pay-child-<id> then confirm-payment-button then payment-done-button. Do NOT rely on inner_text('body') right after tab switch — the previous screen text can linger briefly; instead poll for the target testID (store-screen, add-child-fab, etc.).
